title: Comparison Between Effect of Enoxaparin and Clopidogrel on Improving Pregnancy Rate in ICSI
brief_summary: Comparison between effect of enoxaparin and clopidogrel on improving pregnancy rate in ICSI
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age :20-35yrs.

1. Embryo transfer at 3rd or 5th day after ovum pick up.
2. The transferred embryos are in the four cell stage ,eight cell stage, sixteen cell stage or blastocyst stage.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Age \<20 or \>35 yrs old.
2. Chronic medical disease.
3. Single embryo transfer.
4. Previous ICSI failure.
